home.title: I'm Sin. This is where I build UI and animation.
home.description: A collection of components, UI experiments, and animations I enjoy from all over the web.

animation.title: Sin's Animation Collection
animation.description: Learn it once, keep it here, and never have to reverse-engineer it again.

polaroid.title: Polaroid UI: A little instant-photo component
polaroid.description: An instant-photo stamp component for paired sites or photo walls.

color-mode-button.title: ColorModeButton: An animated theme toggle
color-mode-button.description: A theme toggle collected from a portfolio project. The revised version uses CSS clip-path for both expansion and contraction.

nihilistic-hero.title: Nihilistic Hero: A two-column editorial hero
nihilistic-hero.description: A 16:9 hero layout inspired by an online poster, tested in the laboratory and kept here.

shutter-reveal.title: ShutterReveal: A shutter-slice animation
shutter-reveal.description: A no-scroll reinterpretation of fqzlr.com's shutter effect: five vertical slices enter from alternating directions, then form one image.

wave-reveal.title: WaveReveal + Logo Stroke: A wave reveal animation
wave-reveal.description: A preloader showcase adapted from BenjaminOddou/portfolio, combining SVG strokes with a GSAP wave transition.

interactive-icon-morph.title: InteractiveIconMorph: An interactive icon morph
interactive-icon-morph.description: A menu icon study adapted from BenjaminOddou/portfolio, with GSAP-driven SVG morphing and rotating circular type.
